output.subject: Re: New address
output.body:
Hi ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Congratulations on your move, and thank you for getting in touch with us.

You've asked us to update the mailing address on your joint account to your new address. You mentioned that you first tried to make the change in the app, but it told you to contact us because address changes on joint accounts can't be made there. Thank you for taking the extra step to reach out directly, and we're sorry for any inconvenience of not being able to finish this in the app.

We have passed your request, including the new and previous addresses you sent us, to our Deposit Operations team for review. We will respond within 10 business days. If we need anything further from you, we'll let you know in that response.

If you have any questions in the meantime, or anything else changes, please reply to this email and we'll be glad to help.

Warm regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: This is a service request (address change), not a complaint; reply is written accordingly.
The new address in the email looks malformed: the redaction token is followed by stray text ('ld Spring Landing, NY 10516'). Confirm the full, correct new address before updating.
Check whether the joint account holder's consent or confirmation is needed for the change and add any required steps.
Confirm the customer's identity and that they are an authorized holder on the joint account before making the change.
Decide whether to tell the customer which other records (statements, cards, other accounts) will reflect the new address.
The draft does not confirm that the change has been made. Update the wording if it is completed before sending.
